notes.title: Volt Patrol : My new game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone :)

I wanted to share with you my game [b]Volt Patrol[/b] that i am developing since a year.
It's a different genre and, like Pharmakon, i try to make it original.

Quickly: Volt Patrol is a stealth driving game.

So, if you are intrigued, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1109300/Volt_Patrol/]visit the store page here[/url] to get more details and (maybe?) add it to your wishlist ;)

Screenshot :
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1109300/Volt_Patrol/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1109300/ss_076d443e9ccef37a3c2f8641c30a407ec32af931.1920x1080.jpg?t=1571566648review[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone :)

I updated the game to balance the difficulty and remove a bug from switching language.
I hope it will improve your experience with the game.

I would like to see your review about the game on the steam page so don't be shy ;)

notes.title: UPDATE: FIX
notes.notes:
I updated Paralysis description because the text was off.

Also, I added advices to help players with tips for a better strategy.
I met several players having problems with the difficulty of the game.
I admit the game is hard to master if it's not your kind at all.

I hope these hints will help players to understand what they could change in their strategy to solve the puzzle-combats.

Thanks for being in our community ;)

notes.title: No popup menu will stay hidden forever!
notes.notes:
In a recent review video recorded by Pion, a bug happened in which UI panel menu popup appearing usually while we hover a beast wasn't able to be visible.

The thing is that a condition in the game was saying that if a beast's attack was cut mid-shot by the attacking beast's death, the UI wasn't able to be displayed again.

So, today i fixed it ;)

Here is the video :

https://youtu.be/g1HVnB1zl2Y
